text:
maria: heads-up: proposing we deprecate request.client_region next quarter. drafting a safe playbook for migration, backfill, and billing fallbacks. wanna align here before i send broadly.

jon: what's the high level timeline and cost? :thinking_face:

maria: planning: 8w staged rollout + 2w canary. backfill only last 90 days. rough cost = small S3 export + a streaming enrichment pass; i'll quantify after scope lock.

alex: suggestion: don't remove immediately. write schema_version and introduce request.client_geo_v2, keep old field for 1.5 releases. also add an ingress shim to normalize legacy keys.

sara: dashboards breaking is a big risk. we should scan saved queries/alerts for direct refs to request.client_region and auto-open tickets for owners. also add a temporary derived metric mapping in Console.

maria: draft playbook:
1) announce deprecation + migration checklist.
2) land an enrichment shim that synthesizes client_region='unknown' when missing to keep billing and pivots intact.
3) start a backfill pipeline for 90d window (reads traces, resolves region via IP/header heuristics) and tag backfilled traces with 'backfill.v=1'.
4) set telemetry schema_version header for new producers; encourage consumers to prefer schema_version-driven parsing.
5) canary: producers stop writing request.client_region; shim still synthesizes value. monitor diffs & alerts for 48h.
6) only remove after owners ack and no active alerts.

kevin: two caveats: (1) some customers put region in random headers -> we'll need a small extractor mapping table. (2) billing/keying jobs must default to 'region_unknown' rather than dropping the dimension.

maria: noted. mapping table will be a csv in repo and the ingest compatibility layer will run mapping before schema validation.

ingest-bot: deploy queued: enrichment-shim v0.3 -> staging. changelist: synth-client-region rule + backfill tagging.

alex: also: we should avoid large backfills every time. alternative: lightweight global synth + selective on-demand backfills for finance/CS queries. tradeoff = rollout speed vs historical fidelity.

maria: i like hybrid: global synth at ingest for safety; targeted backfills only when customers/queries need fidelity. keeps rollout fast.

sara: console helpers would help product teams. propose a UI toggle to include/exclude backfilled data in metrics and dashboards.

maria: added ticket for console-migration-toggle.

jon: quick validation queries to run: 
-- find dashboards referencing field:
select dashboard_id from dashboards where text ilike '%request.client_region%';

-- compare billing counts pre/post synth:
select region, count(*) from traces where ts between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-15' group by 1;

maria: thanks. next steps: i'll post a one-pager and schedule a 30m sync with owners. please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the hybrid playbook.

alex: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
sara: :thumbsup:
jon: :thumbsup:
